stem_bark.text: The bark of Neolamarckia cadamba is light brown-coloured and rough. It is longitudinally fissured and flakes off in irregular scales.
stem_bark.text_html: The bark of Neolamarckia cadamba is light brown-coloured and rough. It is longitudinally fissured and flakes off in irregular scales.

seed.text: The seeds of Neolamarckia cadamba are tiny (about 0.5 mm long). There are few seeds in each capsule but they are numerous in each pseudocarp.
seed.text_html: The seeds of Neolamarckia cadamba are tiny (about 0.5 mm long). There are few seeds in each capsule but they are numerous in each pseudocarp.

fruit.text: The pseudocarp (false-fruit) of Neolamarckia cadamba is globose, about 4 cm in diameter with a 2.5 cm long peduncle. The fruit of Neolamarckia cadamba is a small capsule . The capsules are inserted on a fleshy receptacle.
fruit.text_html:
The pseudocarp (false-fruit) of Neolamarckia cadamba is globose, about 4 cm in diameter with a 2.5 cm long peduncle.
The fruit of Neolamarckia cadamba is a small capsule. The capsules are inserted on a fleshy receptacle.

leaf.text: The leaves of Neolamarckia cadamba grow opposite on the stem. The leaf is simple, bright green-coloured above and paler beneath. The leaf is coriaceous and glabrous on both sides. The leaves have a 4-5 cm long petiole . The blade of the leaf of Neolamarckia cadamba is 15-25 cm long and 8-12 cm wide. The shape of the blade is ovate, the apex is acuminate, the base is rounded and the margins are entire. The venation of the leaf is reticulate with a prominent midrib.
leaf.text_html:
The leaves of Neolamarckia cadamba grow opposite on the stem.
The leaf is simple, bright green-coloured above and paler beneath. The leaf is coriaceous and glabrous on both sides.
The leaves have a 4-5 cm long petiole.
The blade of the leaf of Neolamarckia cadamba is 15-25 cm long and 8-12 cm wide. The shape of the blade is ovate, the apex is acuminate, the base is rounded and the margins are entire.
The venation of the leaf is reticulate with a prominent midrib.

habit.text: Neolamarckia cadamba is a thornless, large-sized and deciduous tree growing up to 30-35 m high.
habit.text_html: Neolamarckia cadamba is a thornless, large-sized and deciduous tree growing up to 30-35 m high.

ecology.text: Neolamarckia cadamba is "an early-succession species, it grows best on deep, moist, alluvial sites, often in secondary forests along riverbanks and in the transitional zone between swampy, permanently flooded and periodically flooded areas". ( Orwa C., Mutua A., Kindt R., Jamnadass R., Anthony S., 2009, Agroforestree Database: a tree reference and selection guide )

reproduction_dispersal.text: Neolamarckia cadamba is bisexual (each flower of each individual has both male and female structures). Neolamarckia cadamba is pollinated by a wide variety of insects. The seeds of Neolamarckia cadamba are mainly dispersed by frugivorous birds and mammals.
reproduction_dispersal.text_html:
• Sex distribution :

    Neolamarckia cadamba is bisexual (each flower of each individual has both male and female structures).

  • Mode of pollination :

    Neolamarckia cadamba is pollinated by a wide variety of insects.

  • Seed dispersal :

    The seeds of Neolamarckia cadamba are mainly dispersed by frugivorous birds and mammals.

medicinal.text: Neolamarckia cadamba is used in Ayurveda and Siddha medicines. Neolamarckia cadamba is hepatoprotective, nematicidal, tonic, febrifuge and astringent. The leaves extract is used as a mouth gargle. The leaves decoction is used as a gargle to treat aphthae and stomatitis. The dried bark is used to relieve fever, burning sensation and as a tonic. The bark juice is used in eyes inflammation. The stem is used as a tooth brush in gum infection and dental caries. The fresh juice of the fruit is used to kill worms in sores. Sources : - Arya Vaidya Sala, 1996, Indian Medicinal plants - Basu & Kirtikar, 1918, Indian Medicinal Plants - Quattrocchi, 2012, CRC World Dictionary of Medicinal and Poisonous Plants - Useful Tropical Plants Database, Ken Fern, 2014 (http://tropical.theferns.info)

reforestation.text: Neolamarckia cadamba is a light demander and fairly drought resistant. It is drought resistant and it will grow in a wide variety of situations and soils but all soils need to be free draining. The species is propagated by seeds or by cuttings. 12 hours of soaking in water accelerates the germination process.
reforestation.text_html:
• Planting advice and requirements :

    Neolamarckia cadamba is a light demander and fairly drought resistant. It is drought resistant and it will grow in a wide variety of situations and soils but all soils need to be free draining.
    The species is propagated by seeds or by cuttings.

  • Seed treatments :

    12 hours of soaking in water accelerates the germination process.
